projects.title: CodeArena
projects.description: Developed a backend application using Spring Boot and MySQL. Containerized the application using Docker Compose and configured a 7-stage Jenkins CI/CD pipeline to automate build, testing, and deployment. Integrated GitHub webhooks to trigger the pipeline automatically on code pushes.
projects.shortDescription: Backend quiz application with automated Jenkins CI/CD and Docker Compose deployment.

projects.title: Advanced Bug Tracker and Task Management System
projects.description: A full-stack bug tracking and task management system with role-based access for four user roles. Built with Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT authentication, bcrypt password hashing, 25+ REST API endpoints, and MVC architecture. Includes role-specific dashboards and bug lifecycle management.
projects.shortDescription: Role based bug and task management system with secure authentication and 25+ REST API endpoints.

projects.title: Savvy AI Chat Bot
projects.description: An AI-powered study tool where users select a subject and receive auto-generated quizzes and explanations through an interactive chat interface powered by the Groq AI API. The backend handles prompt construction and JSON response parsing, while a progress dashboard tracks quiz scores across 50+ attempts.
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered study assistant that generates quizzes and explanations and tracks quiz progress.
